related.title: Cray-1：向量鏈結與啟動延遲
related.titleEn: Cray-1: vector chaining and startup latency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：回收證據與結果完整性都需確認；沒有實際雲端部署宣稱。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Verify both cleanup evidence and result integrity; no actual cloud deployment is claimed.
related.difference: 畫元素0、1、63進入加法器及乘法器的時間線；逐列標出資料相依，不把向量指令當一週期完成；76與44皆正確，首末元素無早於依賴的時刻，模型假設隨圖交付。
related.differenceEn: Timeline elements 0, 1, 63 through both units; label dependencies rather than treating a vector instruction as one-cycle completion. Both 76 and 44 match, no element precedes its dependencies, and assumptions accompany the timeline.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 為16節點各畫20+120+10 min三階段，總分鐘除60。
長度 n 的串流以一元素每週期前進；理想鏈結兩算子需 s1+s2+n−1 週期，忽略發射衝突；合成加法啟動6週期、乘法7週期，n=64；對照 n=32，同步時鐘且資料已就緒；名義式 6+7+64-1 = 76 cycles；變更式 6+7+32-1 = 44 cycles。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw 20+120+10-minute phases for each of sixteen nodes and divide total minutes by 60.

An n-element stream advances one element per cycle; ideally chained operators take s1+s2+n−1 cycles, ignoring issue conflicts. Synthetic add startup 6, multiply startup 7 cycles, n=64 versus 32, common clock and ready operands. Nominal 6+7+64-1 = 76 cycles; changed 6+7+32-1 = 44 cycles. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Sierra：主機核心保留與執行緒超額配置
related.titleEn: Sierra: reserved host cores and oversubscription
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：回收證據與結果完整性都需確認；沒有實際雲端部署宣稱。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Verify both cleanup evidence and result integrity; no actual cloud deployment is claimed.
related.difference: 畫四個程序的10核心綁定集合，另列保留核心；應用不可把實體總數當可用數；1與1.2可重算，交接表包含所有執行緒來源與可用核心依據。
related.differenceEn: Draw four disjoint ten-core affinity sets and reserved cores; applications must not equate physical count with allowance. Reproduce 1 and 1.2 with all thread sources and the basis for allowed cores documented.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 為16節點各畫20+120+10 min三階段，總分鐘除60。
r個程序各t個執行緒需要r×t個執行槽；超額比為r×t/C，C是被允許的核心數；合成C=40，r=4，t=10；誤改t=12，其餘配置不變；名義式 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio；變更式 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw 20+120+10-minute phases for each of sixteen nodes and divide total minutes by 60.

r processes with t threads need r×t execution slots; oversubscription is r×t/C for allowed cores C. Teaching C 40, r 4, t 10; compare accidental t 12 with other settings fixed. Nominal 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio; changed 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
